newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka PERC head has no comment on resignation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka PERC head has no comment on resignation.

text.p: The head of Sri Lanka's privatisation department, Rajan Asirwatham, on Monday declined comment on reports he had offered to resign.

"I have no immediate comment to make," Asirwatham, chairman of the Public Enterprise Reform Commission (PERC), told Reuters when asked about reports in newspapers that he had offered to resign by Tuesday.
The Sunday Leader newspaper said Asirwatham had tendered his resignation to President Chandrika Kumaratunga, who is also finance minister.

PERC had been criticised in recent months for its handling of several privatisations including the sale of the government gas distribution monopoly to a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group, the paper said.
The government has said it is considering legal action against the local Shell company for raising the price of gas twice in one year in apparent violation of the privatisation deal.
